title: Project Manager and Foremans
description: Project Manager coordinates Foreman-A through Foreman-E in one council room. Each Foreman owns one 20-worker pool, so 100 workers are shown as five aggregate pools instead of 100 separate chats.

messages.text: I split the build into five simple Foreman packets: A, B, C, D, and E. Each Foreman gets a 20-worker pool; worker chatter stays aggregated unless an exception affects the global run.
messages.systemLog: pm DEBUG partition foremans=A,B,C,D,E foreman_count=5 workers=100 pool_size=20 shared_lock=x0 checkpoints=9

messages.text: Packet A accepted. My pool owns workers 001-020 and will report only pool totals plus blocking exceptions.
messages.systemLog: foreman-a INFO packet=A workers=001-020 blocks=2140 checkpoints=gate_a

messages.text: Packet B accepted. My pool owns workers 021-040 and will keep shared-lock writes at zero.
messages.systemLog: foreman-b INFO packet=B workers=021-040 blocks=1885 locks=shared_axis:x0

messages.text: Packet C accepted. My pool owns workers 041-060 and will pause dependent rows until required gates are green.
messages.systemLog: foreman-c INFO packet=C workers=041-060 blocks=2515 checkpoints=gate_c retry_policy=max2

messages.text: Packet D accepted. My pool owns workers 061-080 and will route uncertain cells to review instead of guessing.
messages.systemLog: foreman-d INFO packet=D workers=061-080 blocks=1610 uncertain=23 gate=review_d

messages.text: Packet E accepted. My pool owns workers 081-100 and will track temporary tags, cleanup, and diff collection.
messages.systemLog: foreman-e INFO packet=E workers=081-100 temp_tag_prefix=tmp/ diff_sink=world/*.diff.jsonl

messages.text: Foreman worker pools may start. Keep the right-side chat focused on pool summaries, checkpoint events, and only the worker exceptions that affect the global run.
messages.systemLog: pm INFO dispatch foreman_pools=5 workers=100 concurrency=100 chat_policy=aggregate_plus_exceptions

messages.text: Worker-pool build phase complete. Foreman-A through Foreman-E flushed diffs, patches, checkpoints, temporary tags, and skill-cache updates for verification.
messages.systemLog: pm INFO complete placed=9274 corrected=7 temp=31 foreman_pools=5 workers=100 out=world/merged_state.json
